Areas of higher rainfall are often upland where it is 
difficult to build. 
• 
Temperature has an influence on both the amount of 
precipitation and evaporation which is why latitude is a 
significant factor in areas of surplus. 
• 
People have a responsibility to use water carefully to 
manage the supplies they receive by using water 
saving irrigation and avoiding wasting water for things 
like golf courses and fountains. 
• 
The biggest reason for the surplus in Brazil is the 
Amazon rainforest which causes very high levels of 
evapotranspiration. 
• 
The biggest reason for the surplus in Canada is the low 
population density which reduces demand for water. 
• 
The biggest reason for the surplus in Papua New 
Guinea is the high precipitation increasing supply.
